 Saturday Night Live 's 52nd season continues tonight with a comedian making history as a first-time Host.
 By Chris Phelan Nov 7, 2026, 8:00 AM ET Druski Says Hosting SNL Is Even Better Than His Childhood Dream Now Playing 1:22 Current Preview Druski Says Hosting SNL Is Even Better Than His Childhood Dream 1:18 Current Preview SNL Host Druski Does an Impression of The Strokes 14:00 Highlight Weekend Update ft. Ben Marshall and Bobby Moynihan Share this on Reddit Share this on Facebook Share this on X Share this by Email Share this by SMS Copy link Add us on Google Key Takeaways
 A new episode of Saturday Night Live airs live on November 7, 2026, at 11:30 p.m. ET on NBC and Peacock, with streaming available on Peacock the following day.
 Comedian and internet personality Druski makes history as the first digital content creator to host SNL , bringing his viral comedy style and popular online characters to Studio 8H.
 The Strokes return as the musical guest for their fifth SNL appearance while continuing their world tour supporting their 2026 album Reality Awaits .
 Saturday Night Live is four episodes deep into Season 52 and has already served up so many surprises. Just last week, not only did Tom Hanks reprise his role as David S. Pumpkins during Halloween episode hosted by Inde Navarrette , Bobby Moynihan also returned as his iconic Drunk Uncle character . 
 How to Watch
 Watch Saturday Night Live  Saturdays at 11:30 p.m. ET on NBC and next day on Peacock.
 Stream Now on This season's retooled cast , dedicated writing team, and its usual incredible lineup of Hosts and Musical Guests have delivered laugh after laugh, and now with another new episode on the horizon, fans can prepare themselves for another evening of comedy.
 So, what should you expect for tonight's edition of SNL ? Well, a viral internet star will take his talents to Studio 8H for the first time — and we've got all the exciting details.

 Jeremy Culhane, host Inde Navarrette, Marcello Hernández, Grace Reiter, Veronika Slowikowska, Kenan Thompson, and James Austin Johnson during the Saturday Night Live “Paw Patrol” sketch on Saturday, October 31, 2026.
 Photo: Will Heath/NBC Is there a new episode of SNL tonight, November 7?
 Yes.
 The fifth episode of Saturday Night Live Season 52 airs tonight, live coast-to-coast at 11:30 p.m. ET/10:30 p.m. CT/8:30 p.m. PT on NBC and Peacock with a first-time Host headlining.
 Can't tune in as it all happens live? Tonight's November 7 show will be available to stream beginning tomorrow, Sunday, on Peacock.
 NBC Turns 100 This Year! On November 15, 1926, NBC aired its first broadcast — and for 100 years, the network has helped define news , sports , and entertainment . Whether you’re starting your mornings with TODAY , laughing on weekends with SNL , or catching the big game on Sundays , NBC has been part of people’s lives for generations. Now in 2026, we're celebrating a century of shared moments, memories, and milestones. A century together. Stay tuned to NBC this fall for stories honoring the shows, characters, and moments you love — both past and present. Because after 100 years, we’re only getting started. Don't forget to stream all your NBC favorites on Peacock right now. 
Plus, tune in to NBC100: The Live Celebration — a three-hour live event toasting to NBC's past, present, and future — on Thursday, December 10 at at 8 p.m. ET on NBC and Peacock.
 Who is the SNL Host for the November 7 episode?
 Druski .
 Druski attends the 2026 BET Awards at Peacock Theater on June 28, 2026 in Los Angeles, California.
 Photo: Frazer Harrison/Getty Images For the first time in SNL history, a digital content creator will step into a hosting role — and there's nobody better suited for that honor than Druski.
 The innovative comedian has made a name for himself in all corners of the internet in recent years, whether it's being responsible for viral memes like "Hands Up" and "What Do You Mean By That?" or writing, starring, and producing long-form satire videos like his 2025 dating show parody video, "Coulda Been Love Episode 1: Meet the Bachelor," which boasts 24 million views on YouTube alone.
 The star's comedy videos often center around over-the-top characters as Druski skewers everything from pop culture to social dynamics — in other words, the star is a perfect fit for SNL .

 Who is the Musical Guest for tonight's November 7 SNL episode?
 The Strokes.
 Albert Hammond Jr, Nikolai Fraiture, Nick Valensi, Fabrizio Moretti and Julian Casablancas of The Strokes attend a meet and greet prior to their concert at The Cosmopolitan of Las Vegas on March 12, 2011 in Las Vegas, Nevada. 
 Photo: WireImage SNL welcomes back New York City's own indie rockers for the fifth time in the band's career. After forming in 1998, The Strokes rose to stardom in the early 2000s thanks to breakout singles like "Last Nite" off their 2001 studio album Is This It .
 The Grammy winners first performed on SNL in Season 27 on January 19, 2002, and six albums and 24 years later, The Strokes will return to Studio 8H to rock the house once again.
 RELATED: Every Musical Guest of SNL Season 52   
 The Strokes are currently in the middle of a world tour in support of their latest album, Reality Awaits, released in July 2026. After taking the stage tonight on SNL , the band will head to Mexico City for more live dates before heading to international locales like Buenos Aires and Melbourne well into the new year.
